# `weekGrid`

Helper: `weekGrid({ days, legend })`  
Kit (`src/ui`): kit gap · status: kit gap  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `WeekStrip` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Seven day columns, each with a header and booking cards and an "Đặt lịch" button.

## Variants

- Booking colour by service

## States

- Day button is a button; others static

## Tokens

field, line, radius-tile, service colours

## Do

- Use for the week view of the schedule

## Don't

- Do not use it for a month view

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Web-only. Seven equal columns.

## Mobile (390)

One list per day.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

**web-only.** 7 day columns of booking cards with "Đặt lịch" per day. 390: one list per day
